title: KHR_animation_events Event
description: A timestamped event attached to an animation.

time.description: Time in seconds when the event fires. Must not be NaN or Infinity.

name.description: Identifier for this event. Used by applications to determine response.

payload.description: Application-specific JSON data attached to this event. Schema is application-defined.

isSync.description: If true, this event is a sync marker for animation alignment.
